$comment: Unshifted characters of the standard Windows layout per language, for navigator.keyboard.getLayoutMap(). Layout names as Microsoft lists them: US (KBDUS), French (KBDFR; chart https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/globalization/keyboards/kbdfr, titled 'French (Legacy, AZERTY) Keyboard'), German (KBDGR; chart https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/globalization/keyboards/kbdgr). The chart pages exist (HTTP 200 checked 2026-10-25) but their key legends are images, so the four characters per layout were NOT read off the chart: assumption, from the layouts' well-known standard form. US has no chart URL here. Unmapped locales keep the host layout (gen warns). Add a layout only with a citable chart and all four codes.
